Both changes are made, in place on the existing dashboard and rule.

1. **'Site health' dashboard:** I added a third panel, "Requests by host". It's a bar chart of request counts by `host.keyword`, built from the "Requests by response code" panel. It sits below the two existing panels on the Kibana Sample Data Logs data view. I read the dashboard back and it now lists all three panels.
2. **'Server errors' rule:** It's now enabled. I enabled it through the API and read it back to confirm.
